builtin.name: read
builtin.condition: always registered; session/read and fetch policy still apply

builtin.name: ask
builtin.condition: ask.enabled and interactive UI/prompt callback exists

builtin.name: eval
builtin.condition: an enabled JS or Python eval backend exists

builtin.name: github
builtin.condition: github.enabled and GitHub/gh integration is available

builtin.name: checkpoint
builtin.condition: checkpoint.enabled and session depth/request rules allow it

builtin.name: rewind
builtin.condition: checkpoint.enabled and session depth/request rules allow it

builtin.name: todo
builtin.condition: todo.enabled; prewalk gating may apply while yield is active

builtin.name: web_search
builtin.condition: web_search.enabled and selected provider/auth can run

builtin.name: write
builtin.condition: always registered; device/session transport policy applies

builtin.name: retain
builtin.condition: memory backend is hindsight or mnemopi

builtin.name: recall
builtin.condition: memory backend is hindsight or mnemopi

builtin.name: reflect
builtin.condition: memory backend is hindsight or mnemopi

builtin.name: learn
builtin.condition: autolearn.enabled and memory backend is local, hindsight, or mnemopi

hidden.name: think
hidden.condition: externalThinking enabled and selected model supports it

hidden.name: yield
hidden.condition: hidden control tool; injected according to session/steering mode

hidden.name: goal
hidden.condition: goal.enabled, unrestricted, and goal state rules allow it

dynamic.name: browser
dynamic.condition: eval active and browser.enabled; backend resolves headless/CDP/relay/cmux

dynamic.name: generate_image
dynamic.condition: unrestricted session, generate_image.enabled, requested/allowed, and provider/model returns image tools

dynamic.name: mcp__<server>_<tool>
dynamic.condition: MCP server config discovered, connection/catalog active, and tool is not restricted/deferred

dynamic.name: <custom-or-extension-name>
dynamic.condition: discovered from capability providers, .omp/tools, compatible roots, plugin packages, or explicit paths; builtin collisions rejected

discovery_rule: BUILTIN_TOOLS/HIDDEN_TOOLS remain the canonical static registry. createTools applies settings, session depth, provider/backend availability, and restricted-session policy. Eval preludes are JS/Python globals and never model tool names. Custom/extension tools are loaded per session/subagent. MCP tools are canonicalized as mcp__<server>_<tool> and may be deferred/presented via xd://. No dynamic surface creates another transcript or execution owner.

cedia_boundary.rule: Adapt the existing OMP RPC/session seam; do not add a second harness or duplicate tool/job/transcript ownership.
